HanbokVisual.title: Aspirational Hanbok Styles & Real Silhouettes
HanbokVisual.intro: Discover refined palace couture, K-drama royal court aesthetics, soft pastel dreams, and modern fusion Hanbok captured on runways and cultural showcases. Find a style you love and match your personalized palette below.
HanbokVisual.notice: These images are editorial styling references from cultural showcases and official media. They are displayed for styling inspiration and do not imply celebrity endorsement or boutique rental inventory guarantees. Use the interactive matcher below to tailor your colors and trip fit.

royalCourtCouture.title: Royal Court Haute Couture
royalCourtCouture.description: Dramatic crimson and gold royal ceremonial silhouette with intricate embroidery, evoking iconic historical K-drama queens.
royalCourtCouture.alt: Royal court haute couture Hanbok on cultural fashion runway

softPastelElegance.title: Soft Pastel Sheer Layering
softPastelElegance.description: Translucent ivory jeogori over airy blush and lavender skirts for a luminous, highly photogenic modern aesthetic.
softPastelElegance.alt: Soft pastel layered modern Hanbok with delicate embroidery

contemporaryPalaceChic.title: Contemporary Palace Chic
contemporaryPalaceChic.description: A refined jade and deep navy ensemble pairing traditional poise with sharp modern lines, favored in period drama heroines.
contemporaryPalaceChic.alt: Contemporary palace chic Hanbok with jade and navy tones

nobleScholarDopo.title: Noble Scholar Dopo Robe
nobleScholarDopo.description: Flowing midnight blue aristocrat robe with stately wide sleeves and refined structural drape, iconic in leading period dramas.
nobleScholarDopo.alt: Male aristocrat dopo robe Hanbok on cultural runway

romanticPalaceWalk.title: Romantic Gyeongbokgung Stroll
romanticPalaceWalk.description: Vibrant jewel-tone silk pairing against historic stone palace courtyards, perfect for unforgettable Seoul travel photos.
romanticPalaceWalk.alt: Traditional silk Hanbok against Gyeongbokgung palace backdrop

modernStageFusion.title: Modern Stage Fusion Hanbok
modernStageFusion.description: Bold gold accents and structured contemporary tailoring popularized by K-pop global stages and modern red carpets.
modernStageFusion.alt: Modern fusion Hanbok design with bold contemporary accents
